title: Nora inventories the old maps (paraphrase D)
topic: A librarian named Nora catalogues a collection of old maps in the city library; a colleague brings a box from the cellar, a student asks for a river map, Nora locks the archive at six
tail_E: Each tiny place name she reads through her magnifying
target_note: Same target as formulations A-C: 'glass' is the near-obligatory completion of 'reads through her magnifying' in the old-maps context (tiny place names); it does not occur in the units or the tail, nor does its German equivalent (Glas / Lupe). ' glass' is a single Pythia token (id 5253). Pilot check with pythia-160m (tail selection only, not a result): p(' glass') = 0.88 after the all-English context, rank 1 (next candidate ' glasses' 0.07); 0.89 after the all-German context and 0.54 after the tail alone (rank 1 in both).
author: LS-NEQ stimulus bank, paraphrase D of family F09
notes: Formulation D: fourth independent re-phrasing of the ten F09A meaning units in both languages (same events, same order, same names Nora and Bremen). Replacements include catalogues old maps in the city library/inventories old maps at the city's library (katalogisiert/inventarisiert, in der Stadtbibliothek/in der Bibliothek der Stadt), oldest map shows Bremen's harbour in fine lines/oldest map shows Bremen's port in slender strokes (zeigt den Hafen von Bremen in feinen Linien/zeigt Bremens Hafen in schmalen Strichen), colleague brings a wooden box from the cellar/colleague hauls a crate up from the cellar (bringt eine Holzkiste/schleppt eine Kiste aus dem Keller nach oben), writes a number on every sheet/assigns a number to each sheet (schreibt/vergibt eine Nummer), paper smells of dust and salt like the sea/paper smells salty and dusty like the coast (riecht nach Staub und Salz/riecht salzig und staubig, Meer/Küste), colours fade at the edges/colours turn dull around the edges (verblassen an den Rändern/werden matt an den Kanten), student asks for a river map that afternoon/student inquires about a river map after lunch (bittet um/erkundigt sich nach, an diesem Nachmittag/nach dem Mittagessen), notes the year in the catalogue/adds the year to the catalogue entry (notiert im Katalog/ergänzt im Katalogeintrag), shelves reach up to the ceiling/shelves go as high as the ceiling (reichen/gehen bis hoch zur Decke), locks the archive at six o'clock/secures the archive exactly at six (verschließt um sechs Uhr/sichert genau um sechs Uhr). 'glass', 'Glas' and 'Lupe' are absent. 'inventarisiert', 'vergibt', 'ergänzt' and 'erkundigt sich' are inseparable or reflexive; no separable verbs ('heraufschleppen', 'eintragen', 'abschließen' avoided). Present tense and positive polarity throughout. Unit 9 reads naturally in German; units 1 and 10 read naturally in English.
